name: Wandering Monk Huilin
title: Brother of the Silent Bell
description: A bald monk with sun-darkened skin and an iron staff scarred by old battles.
dialogue: All paths lead inward, friend. Even the path through bamboo.
I once climbed the Heaven-Reaching Spire. The wind there has a name; it would not give it to me.
If you ever face the Scarlet Lotus, remember: their fire feeds on your fear. Be empty, and you cannot burn.

name: Old Hermit Yun
title: Tea-Master of the Bamboo
description: An ancient man with a beard like silvered moss. He pours tea with both hands and seems to be listening to something just beyond your hearing.
dialogue: Sit. The kettle is already certain you would come.
When the dantian is empty, fill it with breath. When it is full, fill it with stillness.
I traded my sword for this kettle, and have never regretted the bargain.

name: Raftsman Qiu
title: Ferryman of the River of Swords
description: A leathery old man with arms like willow branches. He smells of wet rope and pipe-smoke.
dialogue: Cross? Yes, yes. One spirit stone, or one good story. Stories are dearer.
Sometimes a sword shines from below. I do not look. Once you look, you must remember why.

name: Pillmaster Lu
title: Apothecary of the Crossing
description: A round-faced alchemist whose hands are stained ten different shades of green and ochre.
dialogue: Fresh pills! Fresh pills! Tested on three apprentices and one stubborn dog!
You look pale. Half-price on the qi-gathering pills today only. Today only, mind.

name: Cloth Merchant Mei
title: Silk Trader
description: A bright-eyed young woman in many-colored sleeves. She bargains as if it were a swordfight.
dialogue: Silk from beyond the sea! Cheaper than yesterday, dearer than tomorrow!
Heard the Black Banner cut a courier on the east road. Be careful out there.

name: Gatekeeper Chen
title: Outer Disciple of the Azure Cloud
description: A young man in azure robes, holding a polished broom as if it were a sword.
dialogue: Welcome to the Azure Cloud, traveler. Mind the steps; they are slippery with cloud.
Elder Baixu sees few visitors, but he has been... expecting someone today.

name: Disciple Meilin
title: Inner Disciple, Sword Hall
description: A tall woman with a thin sword at her belt and a quicker laugh than her elders would prefer.
dialogue: If you have come to test the sword hall, do not embarrass me by losing too quickly.
Have you read the Sutra of Empty Sleeves? It is in the library. It explains a great deal — and almost nothing.

name: Librarian Zhao
title: Keeper of the Azure Cloud Library
description: A small, soft-voiced man whose spectacles never quite sit straight.
dialogue: Quiet, please. The scrolls are sleeping.
Take this — a copy of the Sutra of Empty Sleeves. It found you; I am only the courier.

name: Elder Baixu
title: Sword-Elder of the Azure Cloud
description: An old man in white robes whose eyes are the color of frosted river stones. His sword leans against his shoulder as if too tired to stand on its own.
dialogue: So. You came. The bamboo whispered as much.
There is a thing I would ask of you, if you have the heart for it.
Climb the peak only when you are sure of your foundation, child. The mountain has a memory of those who stumbled.
